title: I’ve been building a medieval village sim with Claude, ChatGPT and Godot. Looking for playtesters!
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve recently started working on a medieval village sim called Hearth & Heirs using Claude, ChatGPT, Godot 4, and Blender.

The main goal is to create villagers with personalities, memories, friendships, and grudges that actually make players care about them.

I’ve released a free alpha and I’m looking for playtesters to see if that idea is working. **Did you get attached to any villagers? If so, I’d love to hear their story!** If not, what do you think would make them feel more alive?

Still very early in development, so expect bugs and rough animations. Any feedback is appreciated!

Free demo: https://ynotved.itch.io/hearth-heirs

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/2nd_breakfastt please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

comments.author: 2nd_breakfastt
comments.body: ChatGPT/Claude was used for game design, brainstorming, coding assistance, and artwork generation. Claude for writing, implementing, and debugging code. Godot 4 as the game engine using GDScript. Blender with Claude for 3D modeling and working with game assets
